data.name: Belak
data.gender_notes: Belak is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Hebrew roots 'bel' (God) and 'ak' (power), Belak signifies 'God's power'. This name holds a significant connection to the Bible, particularly the Old Testament where God displays His might through various miracles. The name Belak carries the meaning “God's power” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Belak usually hope their child will grow to embody god's power and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A reminder of God's ever-present power and protection.
data.etymology: Belak belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “God's power.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Belak total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
